'''Elder Torntusk''' is the co-leader of the [[Revantusk tribe]] located on the sacrificial altar at the very top of [[Jintha'Alor]] in the [[contested]] territory of the [[Hinterlands]].

Be careful if you are [[Alliance]] and attempting to obtain the [[Mallet of Zul'Farrak]], Elder Torntusk is a PVP flagged [[Horde]] NPC directly on top of the altar you need - but he is not automatically hostile. Attacking him will flag you PvP, but he will not attack you unless you damage him.

==History==
In his younger days, Elder Torntusk was amongst the [[forest troll]]s that joined the [[Old Horde]] and fought in the [[Second War]]. He was stationed at [[Skulk Rock]] within the [[Hinterlands]] before the Horde was driven from the area by the [[Alliance of Lordaeron]]. In the aftermath of the war, the Revantusk was the only known forest troll tribe to still feel some loyalty to the Horde, which made them a target from the other forest trolls. Eventually, the Revantusk tribe relocated to the coast of the Hinterlands, where they hoped to avoid further notice, and established [[Revantusk Village]]. After the [[Third War]], Torntusk and the Revantusk learned that [[Thrall]] had revitalized the [[Horde]] and entered into a pact of friendship and mutual assistance with them. At an unknown point either during or after these events, he became mates with [[Primal Torntusk]].

At some point, Elder Torntusk was taken prisoner by the [[Vilebranch tribe]] after they launched a bold midnight raid on Revantusk village. Imprisoned within [[Jintha'alor]], [[Vile Priestess Hexx]] sought to sacrifice him to the faceless Blood God, [[Hakkar the Soulflayer]]. However before this dark act could be carried out, she was slain and Torntusk was liberated by the Horde [[adventurer|adventurers]] after they killed [[Hitah'ya the Keeper]] and secured the key she had. Following his liberation, he returned to his mate and tribe.
